reports.text: I enjoy masala tea with ginger and no sugar.

query: How do I like my tea?
expected_meaning: Masala tea with ginger, without sugar; stated preference, not health advice.

reports.text: On weekdays I usually take my evening walk after dinner.

query: When do I usually take my weekday walk?
expected_meaning: Usually after dinner, not a verified event today.

reports.text: I plan to visit the public library on November 20, 2026. I haven't gone yet.

query: What did I plan for November 20?
expected_meaning: Planned library visit; must not claim a completed visit.

reports.text: The repair shop I use is called Sunrise Repairs.

query: What is the name of my repair shop?
expected_meaning: Sunrise Repairs, retained after restart and chat eviction.

reports.text: Correction: I meant upma, not porridge, when I told you my favourite breakfast.

query: What is my favourite breakfast according to my corrected statement?
expected_meaning: Upma, explicitly correcting the earlier claim.

reports.text: For an imaginary example, someone might own a violin and practise on Sundays. This isn't a statement about me.

query: Have I said I actually own and practise a violin?
expected_meaning: No actual personal violin ownership or practice inferred from an imaginary example.

reports.text: The large ceramic vase is in the living room.

query: What have I said about owning a telescope?
expected_meaning: No telescope fact; do not substitute the vase.

reports.text: Remember that I put it there.

query: Where did I say I put the item?
expected_meaning: Clarify object and location rather than inventing either.

reports.text: मुझे कॉफी में कम दूध और बिना चीनी पसंद है।

expected_meaning: Less milk and no sugar; respond naturally in Hindi.

reports.text: Last Saturday I visited the city museum with my cousin.

query: Where did I say I went last Saturday, and with whom?
expected_meaning: City museum with cousin; attributed report, no invented cousin identity.

reports.text: The torch is in the upper cupboard, and spare batteries are in the kitchen drawer.

query: Where did I say the torch and spare batteries are?
expected_meaning: Torch in upper cupboard; spare batteries in kitchen drawer, correctly paired.

reports.text: I listen to classical music while cooking.
Lately I have switched to listening to old Hindi songs while cooking.

query: What do I most recently listen to while cooking?
expected_meaning: Old Hindi songs now; ordinary change retains previous habit as history.

reports.text: I plan to meet my neighbour at the park tomorrow morning.
Cancel what I said about meeting my neighbour at the park. There is no such plan now.

query: Do I still have a saved plan to meet my neighbour at the park?
expected_meaning: Plan withdrawn; no claim of a scheduled reminder or actual meeting.

reports.text: My balcony plants are basil, mint and aloe vera.

query: Which plants have I told you are on my balcony?
expected_meaning: Basil, mint and aloe vera, remembered after restart and eviction.

reports.text: Main kal grocery shop se chawal aur daal laane ka plan kar raha hoon. Abhi gaya nahi hoon.

query: Maine grocery shop se kya laane ka plan bataya tha?
expected_meaning: Planned rice and lentils; no completed purchase claim.

reports.text: Would knitting be an interesting hobby to try?

query: Have I actually told you that knitting is already my hobby?
expected_meaning: No existing knitting habit inferred from an exploratory question.
